kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta and pizza are central (2024–26 reviews); an ajillo, seseri sautéed in lemon butter and an appetizer platter of potato salad, ratatouille and pâté also appear (November 2025).
kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.vegan_detail: Ask. Ratatouille on the appetizer platter (November 2025) and grilled Manganji peppers (topped with cheese, August 2026); most dishes have meat, seafood or cheese.
kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays, or the following Monday when it is a substitute holiday (Tabelog). Often fully booked — book ahead (2025–26 reviews). One drink per person; cards only for bills of ¥4,000 or more; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 31 seats: counter of 7 and tables on the ground floor, tables and a sofa upstairs (Tabelog); a November 2025 reviewer booking through a reservation site saw a ¥7,000 minimum spend for second-floor tables. Dogs welcome inside and on the terrace: say the size and number of dogs when booking, bring a café mat, diapers and a leash; dogs may come in a cart; the shop takes no responsibility for animal allergies or accidents (Tabelog). Children welcome; non-smoking (Tabelog). On Ogawa-dori just south of Sanjo, about 10 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_il_tobanchi_sanjo.notes: [Italian · Ogawa-Sanjo] A renovated machiya near Nijo Castle where dogs sit in with their owners: an appetizer platter, pizzas and pastas, wine by the bottle, and dog meals too. Often fully booked; about ¥4,000–6,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 2 July 2012 (Tabelog). A stylish renovation of a Kyoto townhouse (November 2024 and March 2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Appetizer platter; pasta and pizza; dog-friendly dining.

anecdotes.text: In November 2024, when a couple said they were dining with their dog, the meat came without salt and pepper.
A June 2026 traveller's dog came in a cart, so the staff set a table on the ground floor.
A February 2026 pair found the pasta too salty and the appetizer platter disappointing — about ¥9,000 for two with pizza and three drinks — but were glad to sit indoors with their dog.
A November 2025 diner felt the background music, with ad breaks, did not suit the room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: IL TOBANCHI (イル トバンキ)、バル・イタリアン・バー、中京区小川通三条下る猩々町123、月〜土・祝日 18:00〜22:30 (L.O. 21:30)、日曜休み (振替休日は翌月曜休み)、お1人様1ドリンク制、カードは4,000円以上、31席、犬と一緒に入れる (カフェマット、犬用のおむつ、リード)、犬用のごはん、2012年7月2日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 町家を改装、前菜の盛り合わせ7種、ゴルゴンゾーラのクリームパスタ、カルボナーラ、ピザ、飲み放題つきのコース5,500円 (2025年12月)、満席のことが多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly staff, to dog owners and others alike (March 2025 review); phone service may be Japanese only (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_soan_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. The pho is made with domestic rice noodles, and the menu’s allergen notes for the plain and chicken pho list chicken and seafood but not wheat; the bobun, vegan bún and rice palette set list wheat. No gluten-free claim or cross-contact information is published (Tabelog menu, updated September 2026).
kyoto_soan_gojo.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: a Vegan Bún (¥1,760), crisp seasonal vegetables in a black-vinegar sauce with herb salad, described on the menu as for vegans and as a summer dish — ask whether it is still on; Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options. The pho broth is made from chicken bones (Tabelog menu, updated September 2026).
kyoto_soan_gojo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and café 15:00–18:00 (last order 17:00); Tabelog lists Thursday, Friday and Saturday open and Monday–Wednesday and Sunday closed; the official site gives irregular closing days and posts opening days on Instagram; closed on public holidays (Tabelog). Dinner after 18:00 on a special schedule (Tabelog); 18:00–22:00 by advance reservation only (Leaf Kyoto, December 2025). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats; private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway available (Tabelog). About 5 minutes from Gojo subway station (official site).
kyoto_soan_gojo.notes: [Café · Gojo-Takakura, pho and rice palettes] A café, shop and gallery opened in late 2025 to share good food from around Japan: rice-noodle pho with low-temperature chicken, Asian-style egg rice and ‘Rice Palette’ sets, plus a vegan bún in summer. English-speaking staff. Thursday–Saturday; check Instagram.

roles: Culinary director and food adviser (official site); runs そ・かわひがし in Kyoto (official site)
chef_bio.background: SOAN opened on 30 November 2025 as a “destination store” with four parts — FOOD (dining), TOOLS (shop), LEARNING (classes) and JOURNEY (travel ideas) — on the theme of discovering and sharing deliciousness (official site; Leaf Kyoto, December 2025; January 2026 review). Leaf Kyoto credits its photo to Release, a general incorporated association, whose domain the site uses. The culinary director, 中東篤志 of そ・かわひがし, has shaped the menu with the team since the concept stage (official site); a January 2026 reviewer adds that the menu follows the 24 solar terms.
chef_bio.philosophy: “Table to Arts & Earth”: discovering and sharing deliciousness (official site); all meals made with safe, carefully chosen ingredients and seasonings (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: In October 2026 a diner who came back for the bobun found the limited dish gone and had the chicken pho set instead; the cutlery case held spoons but no chopsticks, which staff brought on request, and staff asked about cilantro before serving.
A December 2025 reviewer had a SOAN bento before an event and called it authentic ethnic food with tasty vegetables.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: SOAN、Table to Arts＆Earth 「美味しい」の発見と共有、京都府京都市下京区五条高倉堺町21番地ジムキノウエダビルディング1階101号、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩5分、京阪清水五条駅から徒歩6分、ランチ11:00〜14:00 (13:30 L.O.)、カフェ15:00〜18:00 (17:00 L.O.)、不定休 (営業日はInstagramで)、2025年11月30日グランドオープン、ライスパレット、カリナリーディレクターは京都「そ・かわひがし」の中東篤志 (コンセプト段階からメニュー開発)。食べログ: SOAN、カフェ・創作料理、木・金・土営業、月・火・水・日と祝日は休み、18時以降のディナーは特別営業、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、テイクアウト可、英語対応スタッフ、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン対応、アレルギー表示あり。食べログのメニュー (2026年9月更新、英語): SOANのフォー (国産米粉麺、低温調理の鶏、自家製ハーブオイル) とアジア風卵かけご飯 (Awaji の卵) のセット1,650円、えびフォーのセット1,870円、ライスパレットのセット1,980円 (Iiyama の米)、Vegan Bún 1,760円 (夏の一品)、SOAN Bobun 1,870円、マンゴーチェー770円、自家製プリン550円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): ライスパレットとお米のポタージュ、SOAN Bobun、鶏フォー、お弁当。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); check Instagram for opening days.

positives.text: A Vegan Bún labelled on the menu as for vegans (a summer dish; allergens wheat, soy, peanuts); Tabelog lists vegan and vegetarian options.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog (menu updated September 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, Saikyo-miso-grilled fish, tempura, fried dishes and set meals; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused izakaya; set meals come with miso soup (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30 (one part of the official site says 14:00; Tabelog 13:30), no lunch bookings; dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Sunday and Monday, with occasional other closures (official site; Tabelog). Phone bookings 14:00–22:00; courses must be booked three days ahead (official site). Payment: cash (official site); Tabelog lists QR payments, no cards. Counter, table seats, tatami room and private room (official site). All seats non-smoking (official site); Tabelog still lists smoking allowed. On Muromachi south of Rokkaku, near Hankyu Karasuma and subway Shijo (official site).
kyoto_kazeya_sugihara.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, fish and sake] A calm, grown-up izakaya past a reception area: counter, booths and tatami rooms. Lunch sets around ¥1,000–1,600 (seafood bowl, sashimi, dashimaki); at night sashimi, simmered and grilled fish, tempura, and courses from ¥5,500. Cash. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Okami (not named; makes the shibazuke, official site)
chef_bio.background: A local izakaya on Muromachi focused on fish, sake from around Japan and about twenty shochu (official site). A January 2025 reviewer has come for seven or eight years, drawn by the owner’s personality.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; squid-ink yaki-somen with shibazuke.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner booked the same day, found singing crickets on display by the entrance, and saw the counter and booths fill, mostly with older customers.
In January 2018 a New Year guest was surprised to be served o-toso to start.
A January 2025 New Year party noted that the all-you-can-drink option had ended.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 口馳八丁 風屋杉原 (かぜやすぎはら)、京都府京都市中京区室町通六角下ル鯉山町514 アトラクタービル1F、お昼11:30〜13:30 (別の箇所では14:00)、夜17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、日曜・月曜定休 (臨時休業あり)、予約受付14:00〜22:00、昼の予約不可、現金、全席禁煙、座敷・個室・カウンター、全国の厳選日本酒、焼酎約20種、お造り盛り合わせ、出し巻玉子、女将手作りの柴漬入りいかすみ焼そうめん、鰆西京焼き、天ぷら盛り合わせ、昼は日替わり定食・海鮮丼・お造り定食・出し巻定食・唐揚定食、大皿コース5,500円〜・会席コース6,600円〜 (税込、飲み物別、3日前までに電話予約)、季節により鍋も。食べログ: 居酒屋・寿司、火〜土 11:30〜13:30・17:30〜21:30、日・月休み、カード不可、QR決済可、喫煙可の表示。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): あん肝と白和え、新じゃがといかの塩辛の揚げもの、鯛の山椒煮、鯖の西京焼き、海鮮丼1,600円、日替わり定食1,000円、お造り定食1,200円、店主の人柄、入口に鳴く虫、お屠蘇、飲み放題は終了、奥の座敷。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; cash.

kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.gf_detail: Ask. Marinated kalbi, yaki-shabu and yaki-suki, chijimi, cold noodles and stone-grilled bibimbap; no gluten information is published (gurunavi; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku house (gurunavi).
kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 daily (last order 21:30), closed irregularly (Tabelog; gurunavi). Groups of 10 or more book by phone (Tabelog); private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: 4 at the counter, 18 at sunken kotatsu tatami seats, 16 at tables (Tabelog). The ground floor is non-smoking; the second floor is a smoking area, closed to under-20s and pregnant guests (Tabelog). Children welcome, with a children’s menu, tableware and chairs (Tabelog). Takeaway samgyetang, oxtail soup and yukgaejang (gurunavi). On Fuyacho south of Nijo, about 5 minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae exit 9 (Tabelog). Opened 17 October 2011 (Tabelog; gurunavi).
kyoto_yakiniku_terusan.notes: [Yakiniku · Fuyacho-Nijo, Kyoto beef since 2011] A spacious house-style yakiniku restaurant with counter, sunken kotatsu tatami seats and tables: Kyoto and Tamba beef, the house yaki-shabu, pot-marinated kalbi to wrap in Kyoto vegetables, chijimi and cold noodles. Non-smoking downstairs; the upstairs floor allows smoking.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 17 October 2011 (Tabelog; gurunavi). The house offers selected Kyoto-area beef — the gurunavi page variously says Kyotanba beef, Tamba wagyu and Kyoto beef — with wine, in an adult hideaway atmosphere (gurunavi).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner came late after work, found the room quiet, and rated the meat fresh and varied, though the staff seemed a little low on energy.
A February 2024 farewell party took the second floor for a course that started with chuck-eye roll and ended with stone-grilled bibimbap.
A July 2024 visitor liked the white rice best and found the meat good but pricey for Kyoto, the kimchi portion small, and no raw-meat dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ぐるなび: 焼肉 天照杉 てるさん (ヤキニクテルサン)、大人の隠れ家的雰囲気、厳選した極上の京丹波牛 (別の箇所では丹波和牛、京都牛)、焼肉に合うワイン、2011年10月17日オープン、ディナー17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、不定休、38席、掘りごたつ席、天照杉の焼きしゃぶ1,980円、壺漬け熟成カルビ (包み京野菜＆味噌付) 1,408円、天照杉の焼すき1,980円、贅沢！厚切りランプ、宴会コース4,000円〜、テイクアウトはサムゲタン・テールスープ・ユッケジャンスープ。食べログ: 焼肉・韓国料理・居酒屋、京都市中京区麩屋町通り二条下る尾張町236-1、毎日17:00〜22:00、不定休、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可、38席 (カウンター4、掘りごたつ18、テーブル16)、1階禁煙・2階喫煙 (20歳未満と妊婦は不可)、10名以上は電話予約、貸切20名まで、子ども歓迎。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 厚切りの肉、好みの厚さの牛タン、山わさび、冷麺、チヂミ、ナムル、いかとにらのチヂミ、石焼ビビンバの締め、白ご飯、価格は高め、店員の元気が今ひとつ (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Ground floor non-smoking; upstairs allows smoking.

existence.note: Tabelog and gurunavi listings; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shutei_sasakura.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, fried turban shell with liver and butter-soy, plain yakisoba, karaage and curry rice bowls; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_shutei_sasakura.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); may close early after 22:00, so call ahead; closed Tuesday (Tabelog; June 2025 review). In 2016: 17:30–22:00 last order, closed Tuesday (Serai, October 2016 issue). No prices on the menu (November 2024). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). Counter seating only (2024–2026 reviews); in 2016, 12 counter seats and 6 at a table (Serai). Booking recommended; full on a Friday in September 2026. Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a lane off Oike, about 5 minutes from Karasuma-Oike subway station (Tabelog), marked by a cedar ball (November 2025).
kyoto_shutei_sasakura.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Oike, a former sushi chef since about 1990] A Showa-era counter down a dim lane, run by an elderly couple: the owner, once a sushi chef and a sake sommelier, still buys and cuts the fish daily. Order the sazae three ways and the plain yakisoba. No prices on the menu; cash; book ahead. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A former sushi chef who had run the bar near Oike for 27 years at age 68 (Serai, October 2016 issue). Reviewers give the founding as 1990 and the owner’s age as 77 (November 2025; foodle, March 2026). Reviewers in October 2026 describe the shop as run by a couple, “an elderly couple”; a June 2025 reviewer thanks both the chef and the owner for the service.
chef_bio.philosophy: Daily sourcing; the fish of the day (2025 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Sazae karaage three ways; plain yakisoba.

anecdotes.text: Asked in November 2025 about the plain yakisoba, the owner laughed that the seasoning is a company secret.
A November 2024 group wandered in off the dim lane, found no prices on the menu, and paid about ¥6,000 each after a long spread.
An October 2026 diner who arrived at opening heard that a booking from overseas visitors was coming later.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: サライ (2016年10月号、2017年10月web掲載): 笹蔵、寿司職人だった西村陽三さん (68歳) が御池通近くで酒亭を始めて27年、由良の赤ウニ3,500円、ポテトサラダ600円、とり肝ソース漬け600円、素焼きそば700円、17時30分〜22時 (最終注文)、火曜定休、カウンター12席・テーブル6席、5,000円〜、予約が好ましい、京都市中京区御池通間ノ町上ル高田町509-4。foodle (2026年3月): 大将は今年77歳、元寿司職人で利き酒師、創業1990年、30年以上、生ダコ、本ししゃも、ポテトサラダ、ペッパーくもこ、サザエからあげ、素焼きそば。食べログ: 酒亭 笹蔵、居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、月・水〜日 18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、22時以降は早じまいの場合あり、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、禁煙。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営むカウンターだけの店、昭和レトロ、サザエの唐揚げを三通りで、素焼きそば、たこのお造り、お造り盛り合わせ、カレー丼、博多鍋、生わさびのご飯、ポテトサラダ、値段のないメニュー、現金のみ、金曜は満席。

cultural_comfort.note: No prices on the menu; cash only; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh pasta of 100% durum semolina (museum page), sandwiches and bread with the sets (2025–26 reviews). No gluten-free option mentioned.
kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.vegan_detail: Not vegan: carbonara with pancetta and egg yolk, bacon tomato pasta, egg sandwiches, ice cream (museum page; 2025–26 reviews). The house soy milk pudding’s other ingredients are not stated; ask.
kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 10:00–18:00; Fridays during special exhibitions 10:00–19:00; last order 30 minutes before closing; closed Monday, and when Monday is a holiday it follows the museum, opening that day and closing the next (museum page, read 2026-11-26). Tabelog lists 10:00–17:30, Tuesday to Sunday. No seat reservations (museum page). No museum ticket needed for the café (museum page; November 2025). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats, terrace seats non-smoking (Tabelog). Breakfast 10:00–11:00 (May and September 2026). Busy at lunch and during popular exhibitions (November 2025; November 2026); in May 2026 a reviewer saw groups waiting while the room was about 60% full. Room for strollers and wheelchairs (September 2026).
kyoto_cafe_de_505_momak.notes: [Café · Okazaki] The café on the first floor of the National Museum of Modern Art, by the great torii of Heian Shrine: glass walls and a shaded terrace over the Lake Biwa Canal, fresh pasta, breakfast sets before 11:00 and dishes tied to the current exhibition. No museum ticket needed; closed Monday; no reservations.

chef_bio.background: The café of the National Museum of Modern Art, Kyoto: a glass-walled café facing the Lake Biwa Canal with an open terrace, popular in cherry-blossom season for the trees along the canal (museum page).
chef_bio.specialty: Fresh pasta of 100% durum semolina from a pasta machine imported from Italy (museum page).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular who usually comes for coffee called it the favourite of all museum cafés for its setting, and found cushions laid on the terrace chairs.
A September 2026 visitor, tired from a crowded holiday bus, found the café nearly empty before 11:00 and stumbled on the breakfast menu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 京都国立近代美術館公式サイト: café de 505 (カフェ・ド・ゴマルゴ)、琵琶湖疏水に面したガラス張りのカフェ、オープンテラス、観覧チケットなしで利用可、午前10時〜午後6時 (金曜日の企画展開催中は午後7時まで)、ラストオーダーは閉店30分前、月曜休み (祝日の場合は開館に準じて営業し翌日休業)、座席の予約不可、デュラムセモリナ粉100%の生パスタ、ベーコンのトマトソースパスタ1,180円、カルボナーラ仕立て1,550円、自家製豆乳プリン700円、白川〜みつ豆と十勝小豆〜750円、コーヒー550円。食べログ: カフェ、左京区岡崎円勝寺 京都国立近代美術館内、40席。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年11月、英語): 朝食のオープンサンドセット760円、展覧会コラボメニュー、焼きカレー、白ワイン600円。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the table; cards and QR accepted. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Museum’s official café page; Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_tato_marutamachi.gf_detail: GF — ask: no gluten-free claim. Paella, Iberico ham, marinated octopus and Greek salad are on the menu, but so are bread, bread skewers and Spanish crepes (2025 reviews); nothing is said about how dishes are made.
kyoto_tato_marutamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Iberico ham, mussels, sardines, squid with anchovy, spinach gratin, cheesecake (2023–25 reviews). No plant-based dishes mentioned.
kyoto_tato_marutamachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–22:00; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reviewers say the opening time is relaxed, so arrive a little after opening (June 2023, September 2025); closures and new dishes are posted on the shop’s Instagram (September 2023). Reservations taken (Tabelog; a September 2023 reviewer booked a weekend evening); private hire from 12 people (July 2025). Visa and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). A standing area and tables (September 2025). The owner cooks alone, so orders take time; paella takes a while, so order it early (September 2023, January and May 2024). Formerly near Teramachi / Kawaramachi, it moved to Marutamachi (April 2022, May 2024).
kyoto_tato_marutamachi.notes: [Spanish bar · Marutamachi] A small, lively, cheerful Spanish bar where the Spanish owner, Tato, cooks alone and talks in Kansai dialect; guests from abroad pin their home town on a world map. Iberico ham, home-style dishes such as “Mother’s Spinach Gratin”, and paella if you order early. Evenings from 17:00, opening time relaxed.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a Spanish owner who has lived in Japan for over 20 years (September 2025) and speaks lively Kansai dialect (April 2022, July 2025); the bar was near Teramachi Shopping Street a few years before 2022, then moved to Marutamachi, and started serving coffee after the move (April 2022). Tato runs the place solo (September 2023); in January 2024 a woman also welcomed guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Iberico ham, home-style Spanish dishes, paella.

anecdotes.text: A September 2023 reviewer: when guests from abroad come in, the owner greets them in their own languages, and anyone who says where they are from puts a pin on the world map.
In July 2025, with the room almost to themselves, a group heard Tato’s stories of Spain and Barcelona; the music went down when the talk got deep.

A September 2025 pair, after a long night of wine and dishes at ¥22,920 for two, called it the most cheerful restaurant in Kyoto and advised coming as a second stop, the energy runs so high from opening to close.

kyoto_astrea_coffee.notes: [Coffee · Shijo-Omiya] A small, plant-filled white coffee stand in a quiet back street, open from 7:30: Australian-style espresso, latte art and a seasonal fruit press sandwich (fig, strawberry) or peach granola. Few seats; no calls or laptop meetings.

chef_bio.background: A specialty coffee stand opened on 16 March 2019 (Tabelog; site). Per reviews: espresso in the Australian style (March 2025); the owner recommends drinks to regulars (September 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit press sandwiches and homemade granola with whole fruit.

anecdotes.text: A regular of six visits comes back every season for the fruit sandwich series: fig in September 2025 and August 2026, peach granola in August 2025 and July 2026, and early-morning coffee in March 2025.
A January 2026 visitor on a business trip liked the latte so much that another one went to the manager at the client’s office as a takeaway gift.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒースタンド、下京区橘町31-1、毎日7:30〜15:00、定休日は変動あり、カード・電子マネー可、QR不可、カウンター席、オープン日2019年3月16日。公式サイト: astrea coffee kyoto、7:30〜15:00、桃のグラノーラ、いちじくとクリームチーズのサンド、日によって提供数に限り。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年9月、英語): オーストラリアスタイルのエスプレッソ、カフェラテ600円、コールドブリュー550円、フルーツサンド、桃のグラノーラ1,500円、植物の多い白い店内、席は少なめ、通話やオンライン会議は不可、11月は窓と扉が開いている、接客が物足りなかったとの声 (2025年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cards and e-money accepted. March and May 2025 reviewers saw many overseas visitors; an August 2026 one saw few. No English evidence found.

kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon (made with Kyoto matcha), tempura, chuka soba (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon broth (dashi base not stated), chicken tempura, chikuwa tempura, chashu on the chuka soba (2026 reviews). Vegetable tempura (pumpkin, sweet potato, eggplant) is on the menu; ask about the broth and the frying oil.
kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00, holidays included (Tabelog). Opened 7 May 2020 (Tabelog). Half self-service: order and pay at the counter, take the udon to your seat, as at Marugame Seimen (August 2026); staff check a table is free before taking the order (November 2026). Reservations, take-out and delivery (Tabelog). All cards, iD and QUICPay, PayPay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 36 seats, sofa seats, wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). A 30-second walk east from Keihan Shichijo station (Tabelog); near Sanjusangendo (August 2026). No waiting at weekday lunch (August 2026).
kyoto_kamogawa_seimenjo.notes: [Udon · Shichijo] A roomy half-self-service udon shop by Keihan Shichijo station, a short walk from Sanjusangendo: thin, chewy udon tinted green with Kyoto matcha, hot or ice-cold, with tempura to add, from ¥650. Open 11:00–21:00 daily; English menu.

chef_bio.background: Opened 7 May 2020 near Keihan Shichijo station as a half-self-service udon shop built on Kyoto matcha udon (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the listing: “Delicious, affordable, and quick!”
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha udon made with Kyoto matcha, without colouring (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor from Sanjusangendo was greeted “Irasshaimase!” by a staff member from abroad and seen off with “Ookini!”, which felt heartwarming.
A September 2026 visitor walking by the river was drawn in by the sign for sudachi udon and found it covered in thin sudachi slices.

kyoto_sumiyaki_kiwami_omiya.gf_detail: Ask: skewers come with salt or a sweet soy-based tare, so ask for salt; avoid fried dishes, the chicken-broth ramen and dashi dishes (2024–2026 reviews). No gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_sumiyaki_kiwami_omiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken yakitori shop; the fried tofu comes in a dashi broth with bonito flakes (July 2024).
kyoto_sumiyaki_kiwami_omiya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Sat 17:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Sunday. When a long weekend includes Sunday, closed on the Monday instead; when Monday is a public holiday, open on the Sunday. Reservations taken (online too); 2-hour limit when busy, and you may be moved to the counter if tables are full. Popular and often fully booked (July 2024; April and October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR codes accepted. 21 seats: a counter downstairs and three tables on the second floor (October 2026); private hire possible. Heated tobacco only in a designated area; e-cigarettes only on the 2nd floor; ashtrays outside. Free Wi-Fi. Menu in English, Traditional Chinese and Korean. Children welcome. Opened 7 July 2018. 1 min from Hankyu Omiya and Randen Shijo-Omiya, on the station rotary.
kyoto_sumiyaki_kiwami_omiya.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo-Omiya, binchotan skewers by the station] A small two-floor yakitori shop on the Hankyu Omiya rotary: rare cuts grilled to order over binchotan, a famously soft liver, tsukune with raw egg, and good sake and aged shochu. Skewers from about ¥180; most spend ¥3,000–6,000. Book ahead. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The shop opened on 7 July 2018 (Tabelog). Reviewers praise the owner's hospitality (October 2025; October and November 2026), "the kind service from the young proprietress" (November 2025), and quick, energetic staff (April 2026). Criticisms: a busy small room where you wait for dishes (December 2024) and a strong tare (April 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog official: "Grilled Chicken Proudly Prepared with Premium Binchotan Charcoal, Focusing on Ingredients, Preparation, and Cooking Techniques."
chef_bio.specialty: Binchotan yakitori and rare cuts; liver; tsukune.

anecdotes.text: July 2024: "I was amazed that the skewers were made fresh right after I placed my order… Surprisingly, the tsukune was also formed on the spot."
August 2025: "My senior colleague insisted, 'The liver here melts in your mouth!' so I ordered it, and I was blown away by how good it was."
December 2024: "It can get quite busy in this small space, so don't expect to dine leisurely. You should also be prepared to wait for the dishes to be served."

kyoto_shichifukuya_shogoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fried sweet-and-sour pork and chicken, dumplings, wontons, spring rolls, noodles and soy-based sauces (2024–2026 reviews); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_shichifukuya_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, chicken, lamb, shrimp and egg dishes; meat-based soups (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shichifukuya_shogoin.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Wednesday; irregular around New Year and Golden Week. Lunch last orders at 14:15 per a July 2026 review. Reservations taken; courses ¥3,500 (Lotus), ¥5,500 (Orchid), ¥8,500 (Peony) by reservation. Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR codes. 57 seats incl. counter and tatami; two private rooms upstairs for up to 20 each (about 40 together). Non-smoking (smoking outside). Takeaway. Menus in English and Chinese; Chinese-speaking staff. Children and strollers welcome. Down an alley off Marutamachi-dori (a sign on the street), 2 min east of the "Kumano Shrine Mae" bus stop; 10 min from Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi or Subway Higashiyama.
kyoto_shichifukuya_shogoin.notes: [Shanghai Chinese · Shogoin near Kumano Shrine, black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork] A hidden local Chinese restaurant down an alley off Marutamachi, run by Shanghai natives: lunch sets around ¥1,000 led by black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork, and big menus and banquet rooms at night. Cash only. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Staff (unnamed; Shanghai natives per a July 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe Shanghai home cooking "run by Shanghai natives" (July 2026) and say "All the staff here are Chinese, but the seasoning is tailored for Japanese tastes" (February 2025); it is popular with locals and hosts banquets upstairs (2026 reviews). Criticisms: slow service for a dish (June 2026), small portions for the price (July and August 2026), mini fried rice served within a minute and a wonton broth that tasted of powdered soup (July 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog official: "Enjoy authentic Shanghai cuisine at reasonable prices!"

anecdotes.text: February 2026: "There are not many places in Kyoto that serve black vinegar sweet and sour pork, so I really appreciate Shichifukuya. The price has gone up since my last visit, but it's still just JPY 980."
July 2026: "I arrived just after 14:00 and found three staff members lined up at the counter enjoying their lunch. They welcomed me with a cheerful 'Irasshaimase' while eating."
September 2026: "I went for a light option: Hong Shao Rou Mian, which is braised pork belly noodles. It was piping hot, and the meat was tender and melted in my mouth."

kyoto_gyu_kimura_omiya.gf_detail: Ask: the harihari hot pot and sukiyaki use a sukiyaki-style broth and finish with udon; yakiniku comes with sauces (2023–2026 reviews). Salted tongue and salt-and-pepper charcoal toban-yaki are on the menu, but no gluten-free option is stated.
kyoto_gyu_kimura_omiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu restaurant — beef hot pots dipped in raw egg, yakiniku, beef sushi and carpaccio (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gyu_kimura_omiya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun 17:30–22:30 (food L.O. 21:00, drinks 22:00); closed Thursday. Reservations taken; tell the shop which dishes you want when booking; sukiyaki normally needs a reservation, though a same-day phone booking worked (September 2025). Seating charge ¥450 per person for the appetizer, none with a course. Cards, e-money and QR codes accepted. 26 table seats on the 2nd and 3rd floors, partitioned booths (March 2025); a room for 12–20 and private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Children welcome. Tabelog lists parking, noting coin parking nearby. Opened 1 July 2002. At Omiya-Takatsuji, 7 min south of Hankyu Omiya / Randen Shijo-Omiya.
kyoto_gyu_kimura_omiya.notes: [Wagyu hot pot and yakiniku · Omiya-Takatsuji, harihari nabe] A calm two-floor wagyu restaurant south of Shijo-Omiya: the signature beef-and-mizuna harihari hot pot (course ¥6,200), sukiyaki, and lean-cut yakiniku with a well-loved wagyu carpaccio; walls of celebrity autographs. Around ¥6,000–10,000. Book ahead. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2002 (Tabelog). A 2026 reviewer says it is run directly by a butcher shop and that other restaurants share the name; the butcher is not named. Reviewers mention signed celebrity photos on the walls (December 2024; 2025–2026) and a feature on Akiko Hinagata's TV show "A Life-Changing Restaurant" (January 2025), and praise staff who explain the hot pot and grill (2024–2026). Criticism: the course portion was a little small for one diner (November 2024); one diner found harihari nabe and sukiyaki hard to tell apart (March 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Tabelog official: "we offer carefully selected fresh Wagyu beef from across the country."
chef_bio.specialty: Gyu harihari nabe; lean-cut yakiniku; wagyu carpaccio.

anecdotes.text: June 2024: "We cooked the meat with mizuna, wrapped it, and dipped it in egg. Unlike the heaviness often associated with sukiyaki, this dish disappeared quickly."

January 2025: "there happened to be a noisy group of about ten locals celebrating a New Year Party right behind us. However, the staff was very considerate and kept checking in with us, saying, 'Sorry for the noise.'"

July 2026: "This is a favorite spot in Kyoto where you can fully enjoy the deliciousness of Wagyu, thanks to its management by a butcher shop… this place truly makes you appreciate the flavor of lean cuts."

kyoto_kashiwatoku_gojo_omiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon, soba and tempura batter (2023–2026 reviews); no gluten-free option stated.
kyoto_kashiwatoku_gojo_omiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the dashi is made from bonito flakes and kombu (owner, quoted in December 2024 and April 2023 reviews); herring, chicken, egg and fish-cake toppings.
kyoto_kashiwatoku_gojo_omiya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:00–19:00; Sat 11:00–15:30; closed Sunday; hours may change, so check first. Open on 31 December for year-end soba (2023 and 2024 reviews). kyoto_kashiwatoku_gojo_omiya.notes: [Udon and soba · Gojo-Omiya, an elderly couple's Showa noodle shop] A spotless, old-fashioned neighbourhood noodle shop run by a friendly elderly couple: bonito-and-kombu dashi, ¥600 kitsune udon, curry udon and a hearty ¥1,000 nabe-yaki udon, with Kinugasa-don on the side. Cash only. Weekday lunch to early evening; Saturday lunch; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe "the elderly chef" (November 2024), "The couple running the place" (March 2025) and "the two elderly owners" (February 2026), a chef who chats with customers and steers first-timers through the order (November 2025; August 2026), and locals greeting the chef warmly (November 2024). The Showa-era room is old but well kept (2024–2025). A November 2025 reviewer saw a notepad and pencil on each table and guessed they were for talking with overseas guests. Criticism: the oyakodon egg had a slimy, starch-thickened texture (March 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: The owner, asked about the broth (April 2023 review): "We use high-quality bonito and kombu kelp for our broth."
chef_bio.specialty: Bonito-and-kombu dashi; kitsune udon; nabe-yaki udon.

November 2025: "With a smile, the chef asked, 'Would you like meat in your curry udon?' and 'Do you want rice too?' It felt like I was being guided through the ordering process."
January 2026: "Kitsune Udon JPY 600, tax Included. With just six 100-yen coins, I was completely satisfied both in body and spirit!"

kyoto_ginnan_shichijo.gf_detail: Ask. Nama-fu (wheat gluten), yuba pizza, kara-age and sashimi; no gluten information (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ginnan_shichijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, Omi beef, pork belly and dashi dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ginnan_shichijo.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 17:30–24:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 29 seats: a 7-seat counter on the first floor, 12 at sunken-kotatsu tables on the second, 10 at tables, plus a tatami room on the third floor (Tabelog; March 2026). Non-smoking, with a smoking room (Tabelog). Smartphone ordering (April 2025). Courses with all-you-can-drink incl. premium sake (February, March and July 2026). Walking distance from Kyoto Station, near Higashi Honganji (April 2025; July 2026).
kyoto_ginnan_shichijo.notes: [Creative izakaya · Shichijo near Kyoto Station, yuba and sake] A three-floor izakaya a walk from Kyoto Station for Kyoto ingredients made playful — fresh yuba, nama-fu, teriyaki yuba pizza, Omi beef — with a long sake list and good-value all-you-can-drink courses. Counter, kotatsu and tatami rooms; closed Monday. Flagged: sister of the yuba café ICHOYA.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site presents ぎんなん alongside ICHOYA, a café near Nishi Honganji, as creative Japanese places using yuba and Kyoto vegetables. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 pair walked over from the Kyoto Tower side looking for nama-fu and found the whole counter free.

cultural_comfort.note: Smartphone ordering; near Kyoto Station.

kyoto_botan_shogoin.notes: [Bar-izakaya · Shogoin, wild boar and garden vegetables] A friendly little bar-izakaya in Shogoin for wild-boar dishes — terrine, courses — and tapas loaded with vegetables from the shop’s own garden, with a cheerful owner behind the counter. Open Wednesday to Saturday evenings; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a cheerful owner and vegetables from the restaurant’s own garden (January 2025; February 2026). Open since June 2014 (Tabelog). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 regular dropped in without a booking after spotting the lantern, for the usual tapas platter and boar terrine.

kyoto_nakaso_tango_kojinguchi.gf_detail: Ask. Courses and à la carte of sashimi, tempura, simmered dishes and amadai shabu-shabu with a dashi broth; no gluten information (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakaso_tango_kojinguchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Tango seafood (amadai, mackerel, crab) and dashi (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_nakaso_tango_kojinguchi.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last orders 21:00); closed Tuesday and Wednesday (own site; Tabelog, which adds that hours may vary by month). Cards (Tabelog). Seats: own site says 8 at the counter, 4 at tables and a 6-seat private room; Tabelog says 16 seats — 6 at the counter, a table and a semi-private room (both checked 2026-11-26). Month and Snow kaiseki courses need booking by the day before; the guji shabu-shabu by two days before; cancellation fee 50% from noon the day before, 100% on the day (own site). Non-smoking, with a smoking booth (Tabelog). No parking (own site). On Kawaramachi south of Kojinguchi (Tabelog). About five years old (February 2026).
kyoto_nakaso_tango_kojinguchi.notes: [Japanese · Kawaramachi-Kojinguchi, Tango seafood and sake] A calm little restaurant showcasing Tango, Kyoto’s northern coast: Tango amadai shabu-shabu, seasonal fish, crab in winter, and sake from local Tango breweries, from a Tango-born chef — as courses or à la carte. Kaiseki from ¥8,800 (own site). Closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Flagged: run by 中山商事株式会社 of Kyotango (a supplies wholesaler with a food division).

chef_bio.background: The site says the chef was born and raised in Tango, wanted to cook from childhood and trained for over ten years. The receipt invoice number belongs to 中山商事株式会社 (京丹後市), whose site lists wholesale, food-service and well-being divisions; no other restaurant of the company was found. A February 2026 reviewer heard it has been open about five years.
chef_bio.philosophy: To share Tango’s appeal through its ingredients (own site).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 diner, who had only ever had amadai as sashimi or grilled, was won over by the shabu-shabu course and the talk on Tango sake.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 中摠 丹後 (なかそう たんご)、中山商事株式会社、京都・上京区の和食店、丹後の地で生まれ育った料理人、10数年の修行、丹後の食材を通じて丹後の魅力を、丹後ぐじの旨味しゃぶ13,000円 (税込、2日前までに予約)、締めはぐじと野菜の雑炊、おまかせ会席 (花会席8,800円、月会席14,300円・雪会席19,800円は前日までに予約)、キャンセル料は前日12時以降50%・当日100%、席数はカウンター8・テーブル4・個室6、月替わりの献立 (丹後ぐじ、松茸、天橋立の鯖の桜干し、コッペ蟹、蟹雑炊)、駐車場なし。中山商事株式会社: 京丹後市、卸売・飲食・Well-being事業部。食べログ: 上京区河原町通荒神口下ル上生洲町240、月・木〜日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火・水曜定休、月により変動、カード可、16席 (カウンター6、テーブル1、半個室1)、禁煙 (喫煙ブースあり)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 丹後料理、ぐじ鍋のコース、刺身・天ぷら・煮物、丹後の地酒、日本酒は半合から、開店5年。

cultural_comfort.note: Calm Japanese restaurant; staff explain Tango sake.

kyoto_le_pont_kojinguchi.gf_detail: Ask. Courses with homemade bread, soups, pâté, steaks and crème brûlée; the maitake fritter has a beer batter; no gluten information (own site; Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_pont_kojinguchi.vegan_detail: Ask. Organic Hokkaido vegetables are central (soups, maitake steak), but nothing is described as vegan; the courses include meat and fish (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_le_pont_kojinguchi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday lunch 11:30–14:00 (last entry 13:00) and dinner 18:00–22:00 (last orders 21:00); closed Monday (own site; Tabelog). Tabelog also lists closures on the second and fourth Tuesdays; the own site gives Monday only (both checked 2026-11-26). Cash only: no cards or e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: counter and tables by a small garden downstairs, tables under beams upstairs (Tabelog). Completely non-smoking; no parking; 2 min from the 荒神口 city-bus stop, 3 min from Kawaramachi-Marutamachi (own site). In a renovated 120-year-old townhouse just north of Kawaramachi-Marutamachi (Tabelog; June 2026). Open since 13 August 2010 (Tabelog).
kyoto_le_pont_kojinguchi.notes: [French · Kawaramachi-Marutamachi, Hokkaido vegetables] A relaxed French restaurant in a 120-year-old townhouse with a small garden, from a chef who cooked in Toronto for 20 years (Tabelog): organic vegetables from Hokkaido farms, homemade Haruyokoi bread and good-value lunch sets from ¥2,500. Cash only; closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text says the chef honed skills in Toronto, Canada, for 20 years. A May 2026 reviewer praises the service of “the lovely couple”. Open since August 2010 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Simple grilled and sautéed dishes that let Hokkaido farm vegetables speak (Tabelog shop text).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner was most impressed by a chilled soup of Furano corn, then chose sea bream for the main.

kyoto_yakiton_nabeya_omiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled pork offal (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiton_nabeya_omiya.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday incl. public holidays 16:00–23:00 (food last orders 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday; may close early when skewers sell out, or for supply reasons (Tabelog). kyoto_yakiton_nabeya_omiya.notes: [Yakiton · south of Shijo-Omiya, pork skewers] A busy little yakiton bar bringing Tokyo-style grilled pork offal to Kyoto: famously fresh liver grilled rare with sesame oil, tongue and skirt, with Hoppy and simple sides. Cuts sell out — book and come early. ¥165 seat charge; cash only; smoking allowed; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Open since July 2022 (Tabelog). No operator details were found.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner came back within days for the liver, piled with green onion and garlic in sesame oil.

kyoto_osteria_k_ozaki.vegan_detail: Ask. Some vegetable appetisers (sweet potato, broccoli) appear, but most dishes use seafood, meat or cheese (2019–2025 reviews).

kyoto_osteria_k_ozaki.notes: [Italian · Shijo-Omiya] A relaxed upstairs osteria with sunset views over the Omiya rotary: an omakase course with chewy homemade pasta, or carpaccio, clams and salsiccia with white wine. No charge; open to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: an Italian osteria that moved in February 2019 from a counter shop to the second floor of 喫茶ハットリ at Shijo-Omiya; the chef often comes out to the dining room (2019 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner, full to the brim after the omakase course, singled out the pâté and the very chewy pasta.
A July 2022 solo visitor who does not drink at all finally came in after work and felt healed by the food and care.
An August 2019 guest took a window seat to watch the sunset over the Omiya rotary.

Obanzai by weight and fresh bento to take away (official site). At Karasuma-Marutamachi, by Marutamachi Stn exit 2 (official site; August 2026 review). The official site names the shop 京うまれ 烏丸丸太町店. Opened 1 November 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoumare_gohan_biyori.notes: [Obanzai set meals · Karasuma-Marutamachi] A counter set-meal shop by Marutamachi Station: pick a main and Kyoto-vegetable obanzai from the showcase, or try the Tanba-chicken oyakodon — all from Kyoto-grown ingredients. Weekend breakfast; take-away bento too.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: an obanzai and set-meal shop opened November 2016, committed to eating local — Kyoto beef, pork, chicken, rice and market vegetables bought each morning — with a bento and by-weight deli counter. Most reviewers (2024–2026) are happy; an April 2025 diner found the katsu-don average, and a February 2026 diner found the pork chop average and already cold.
chef_bio.philosophy: 地のものを地で食す — eat local food locally (official site).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor just before 7 p.m. chose Kamo eggplant dengaku, marinated smoked salmon and chicken neck with ponzu, and loved each one.
A March 2025 diner who missed the sold-out Kujo green-onion oyakodon found joy in a sencha ice cream with real tea leaves.
A November 2025 regular praised the plump shrimp tempura and juicy fillet cutlet fried in fresh oil.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都でうまれたおばんざいのお店「京うまれ」、地産地消、京の肉、京の都もち豚、丹波あじわい鶏、京都産コシヒカリ、毎朝市場から仕入れる京野菜、ソースやドレッシングも店で手作り、店内飲食、お惣菜の量り売り、できたて弁当のテイクアウト、上京区烏丸通丸太町上る春日町434、11:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、不定休、土日・祝日のみ8:00〜11:00 (L.O.10:30) 朝食、朝食は予約可。食べログ: 日本料理、11:30〜21:30、予約不可、サービス料なし、カード・交通系IC 可、30席、禁煙、2016年11月1日開店。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): おばんざいセット (主菜1品と副菜3〜4品) 1,300〜1,480円、親子丼1,150円、チキン南蛮定食1,680円、かつ丼1,280円、えび天とヒレかつの定食、日替わり、煎茶のアイス、食後のコーヒー100円。

cultural_comfort.note: Choose obanzai from the showcase by pointing; cards and IC.

kyoto_gochiya_shiokoji.gf_detail: Ask. Salt-grilled wagyu, kalbi and horse sashimi may suit, but shrimp mayo is battered, wings are soy-glazed and pizza and pasta contain wheat; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gochiya_shiokoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: a meat-focused izakaya; only sides such as fries and fresh spring rolls appear (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gochiya_shiokoji.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–24:00; closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — the shop always calls back to confirm (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 (Tabelog service charge and fee, original 300円). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and QR (PayPay, d Barai); no e-money (Tabelog). 50 seats with sofas and sunken seating; smoking allowed; private hire for 20–50; wheelchair access (Tabelog). 1F 三ツ林ビル, 3–5 min walk from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gochiya_shiokoji.notes: [Meat izakaya · near Kyoto Station] A roomy party izakaya three minutes from the station for wagyu kalbi, A5 steaks and horse sashimi with fairly priced wine. Reviews are mixed on service and upkeep (2023–2026). Smoking allowed; ¥300 charge.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a long-running creative izakaya near Kyoto Station — a March 2026 guest returned after 16 years — centred on A5 wagyu and party courses. Several reviewers (2023–2026) praise the kalbi and steaks but mention slow or brusque service, and two (January and April 2025) mention cleanliness concerns (insects; a sticky floor), while a September 2025 diner found the interior clean. A December 2023 diner found the horse meat, tongue and ribeye gristly, and a July 2024 diner found a metal fragment in the ribeye, which staff said came from the grill and returned the same dish cold without an apology.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 guest returning after 16 years found the kalbi incredibly delicious.
A March 2026 weekday diner liked trying three kinds of reasonably priced izakaya steak with beer.
A September 2025 smoker was glad to light up over carpaccio, horse sashimi and garlic gizzard.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・創作料理・焼肉、下京区東洞院通り七条下ル塩小路町520 三ツ林ビル 1F、毎日 11:30〜14:00、17:30〜24:00、年末年始休み、予約可 (店から確認の電話)、チャージ300円、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・QR (PayPay・d払い) 可、電子マネー不可、50席、ソファ席・掘りごたつ、喫煙可、20〜50名で貸切可、車いす可、紹介文: A5ランクの和牛と厳選素材の創作料理、宴会向け。口コミ (2023年〜2026年3月、英語): 和牛カルビ、3種のステーキ、塩とゆずこしょうのステーキ、リブロース、牛タン、馬刺しの盛り合わせ、カルパッチョ、生春巻き、軟骨の唐揚げ、砂ずりのガーリック炒め、名古屋風の手羽先、えびマヨ、長芋と明太子のグラタン、ポテトサラダ、ピザとパスタ、手頃なワイン、飲み放題のコース。接客や清潔さに不満の口コミもある (2023〜2025年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed; ¥300 charge; the shop calls to confirm bookings.

kyoto_ahoudori_shogoin.gf_detail: Ask. Salt yakitori may suit, but tare, fried skewers, fried cartilage and glazed wings involve wheat or soy; no gluten information (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ahoudori_shogoin.vegan_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled vegetables, cabbage and smashed cucumber appear, but the menu centres on chicken (official site; 2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ahoudori_shogoin.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:00); summer and New Year breaks (official site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted; seats booked online may differ on arrival (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥330 including tax (Tabelog original お席代 330円（税込）); a March 2026 reviewer found menu prices shown before tax. No late-night surcharge (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Ordering by smartphone (December 2025). 37 seats per Tabelog (1F 9 counter, 6 table, a private room; 2F 24 table); the official site gives 47 seats (1F 9 counter, 8 table, a private room; 2F 14 table). Non-smoking (official site); non-smoking with a smoking space (Tabelog). On Marutamachi-dori right by the Kumano Shrine bus stop, 8 min walk from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 5 September 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ahoudori_shogoin.notes: [Yakitori izakaya · by Kumano Shrine, to 1:00] A lively, friendly student-priced yakitori bar where the staff shout “kanpai” with every beer: ¥99 highballs, charcoal skewers, sweet-spicy wings and dashimaki. ¥330 seat charge; prices may be shown before tax.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site and Tabelog: one of four アホウどり yakitori bars that 株式会社アホウプロジェクト runs in Kyoto’s student districts, opened September 2018; the company says it won first place nationally at 居酒屋甲子園 and aims to expand to student districts across Japan; its site describes the Shogoin shop as relaxed, known for charcoal yakitori, grilled vegetables and sake. Reviewers (2023–2026) praise the friendly young staff and prices; a May 2025 diner found the food average, and a January 2026 diner waited about 30 minutes for food and drinks on a fully booked night.
chef_bio.philosophy: A yakitori bar students can visit twice a week (official site; Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 second-stop drinker was startled when the whole staff cheered “Kanpai!” as the beer arrived.
An October 2026 passer-by was lured in by ¥99 highballs and ¥199 giblet stew on the sign.
A January 2026 pair catching up rated the chicken liver and neck skewers and the wings especially highly.
A November 2026 diner praised the service and the oden daikon, perfectly soaked in flavour.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (株式会社アホウプロジェクト): 京都の学生街で「週2で通いたくなる焼鳥屋アホウどり」を運営、居酒屋甲子園で全国1位、店舗は北野白梅町店、京大前店、同志社前店、聖護院店と、からあげのテイクアウト店。聖護院店: 左京区聖護院山王町16-28、17:00〜25:00 (L.O.24:00)、定休日なし (夏季・年末年始休暇あり)、47席、各種キャッシュレス、全席禁煙、炭火焼き鳥と炭火野菜、日本酒も豊富、落ち着いた雰囲気。食べログ: 焼き鳥・居酒屋、17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O.0:00)、予約可、お席代330円 (税込)、深夜料金なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、37席、禁煙 (喫煙スペースあり)、生ビール290円、ハイボール99円、2018年9月5日開店。口コミ (2023年〜2026年11月、英語): 学生向けの値段、乾杯の掛け声、スマホで注文、焼き鳥の盛り合わせ、レバーとせせり、甘辛の手羽先、半熟卵のポテトサラダ、だし巻き、月見つくね、ヤンニョムチキン、季節の限定メニュー、税抜き表示 (2026年3月)、料理と飲み物に30分ほど待った (2026年1月、満席)、おでんの大根 (2026年11月)。公式サイト: 全国の学生街へ展開することを目指している。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by smartphone; ¥330 seat charge; prices may be pre-tax.

kyoto_laparte_nishihonganji.gf_detail: Ask. Allergies and restrictions must be stated when booking, and requests on the day may not be possible (Tabelog). No gluten information.
kyoto_laparte_nishihonganji.vegan_detail: Ask when booking: dietary and religious restrictions are requested in advance (Tabelog); courses include duck, pork, octopus and fish (2022–2024 reviews).
kyoto_laparte_nishihonganji.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday and holidays: lunch 12:00–15:00 (last seating 13:00), dinner 18:00–22:00 (last seating 19:00); closed Sunday and Monday, but open on the Sunday before a Monday holiday (Tabelog). Reservations: state allergies, dislikes and religious restrictions (or “none”) when booking; one course per person; call if arriving early (Tabelog). Courses only, no à la carte; guests arriving before opening may have to wait; a booking may be cancelled if the party is 30 minutes late without contact; the menu can change on the day (official site, 2026-11-26). Service charge 10%, no cover (Tabelog original サービス料10%、チャージ料金なし). Cards and iD/QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). 10 seats, counter by the open kitchen and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2022 reviews). Down an alley near Nishi Hongan-ji; coin parking to the west (2022; September 2024). Opened 10 July 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_laparte_nishihonganji.notes: [French · near Nishi Hongan-ji, 10 seats] A casual neighbourhood bistro where a Loire-born chef with 11 years under Alain Ducasse cooks witty, colourful courses with Japanese ingredients; the chef’s wife hosts. State allergies when booking. 10% service; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born in 1985 in the Loire region of France; after culinary school in France, worked in Michelin-starred restaurants in Paris, Osaka and New York, then became executive chef at ヴォヤージュ in Macau and at ブノア京都 in Kiyomizu; left Alain Ducasse after 11 years to open L’aparté (French for a private aside) in July 2022; also known for house-made bread and baked sweets. Per reviewers: trained at Alain Chapel and also worked at Benoit in Osaka (October 2022). The chef’s wife, a Japanese designer who loves wine, hosts and chooses the wines with the chef; a second chef completes the team of three (October and December 2022 reviews). Reviewers differ on the chef’s Japanese: fluent (October 2022), somewhat limited (December 2022). Most reviews are warm; an October 2023 diner found the portions small and the dishes not to taste, a December 2022 diner found some wines cheap-tasting, and an October 2026 diner felt the price high for the casual setting.
chef_bio.philosophy: Respect for the roots and fundamentals of French cooking, blended with local ingredients and techniques (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2023 diner decoded the riddle-like menu — “8” was octopus, after its legs.
Guests on the first anniversary in July 2023 were poured champagne on the house and loved the origami menu.
An October 2022 lunch began with fresh carrot juice poured by the chef in front of the open kitchen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: フレンチ・ビストロ、下京区西若松町247-3、火〜土・祝日 12:00〜15:00 (最終入店13:00)、18:00〜22:00 (最終入店19:00)、日・月休み (月曜祝日の場合は前日の日曜営業)、予約時にアレルギー・苦手・宗教上食べられない物を記入 (なければ「なし」)、当日の要望は対応できない場合あり、1人1コース、サービス料10%、チャージ料金なし、カード・iD・QUICPay 可、QR 不可、10席、禁煙、2022年7月10日開店、紹介文 (英訳): 日本を愛するフランス人シェフのモダンフレンチ。公式サイト: オーナーシェフ Anthony Bâcle (アントニー・バックル)、1985年フランス・ロワール地方出身、パリ・大阪・ニューヨークのミシュラン星付きレストラン、マカオの「ヴォヤージュ」と「ブノア京都」でエグゼクティブシェフ、アラン・デュカスのもとで11年、2022年7月開店、自家製のパンや焼き菓子、コースのみ、Heritage 8,000円・Menu Aparté 15,000円 (税込)。口コミ (2022年〜2026年10月、英語): シェフは Alain Chapel で修業し Alain Ducasse のグループで世界各地 (マカオなど) のあと Benoit (大阪、京都)、デザイナーの妻がホステス、西本願寺近くの路地、オープンキッチンのカウンター、折り紙のメニュー、なぞなぞのような料理名、たこの「8」、近江の鴨と九条ねぎ、Heritage のランチ8,000円 (税別)、5品のランチ9,680円 (税・サ込み)、Coravin のグラスワイン、ペアリング。

cultural_comfort.note: French chef; the official menu is in Japanese and English; state dietary needs when booking.

staff_allergy_handling: Allergies, dislikes and religious restrictions requested at booking; same-day requests may not be accommodated (Tabelog).

kyoto_kaikatei_maruyama.gf_detail: Ask. Curries (including a katsu curry), sandwiches, fried dishes and roll cake; no gluten information is published (gurunavi; Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kaikatei_maruyama.vegan_detail: Ask. A seasonal Kyoto-vegetable curry and a curry of fresh wheat gluten, Kujo leek and fried tofu are listed (gurunavi), but no vegan claim or broth information is published.
kyoto_kaikatei_maruyama.hours_raw: Tabelog (official information): 9:00–18:00, closed Wednesday, also closed irregularly. gurunavi: Monday–Friday 11:00–17:00, Saturday, Sunday and holidays 10:00–17:00, open into the evening only during Hanatoro, cherry-blossom and autumn-leaf seasons, closed irregularly. An April 2023 visitor found it opening at 10:30, with lunch from 11:00 and a morning menu before that. gurunavi currently shows a "temporarily closed" notice with no dates; a diner visited in August 2025 — call ahead (075-561-2115). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards (Tabelog). 60 seats (Tabelog; about 60 in an April 2017 review, counter and tables) or 70 with a terrace added in July 2016 (gurunavi). Smoking: Tabelog says allowed (all seats smoking in April 2017); gurunavi says fully non-smoking inside. English menu (gurunavi). Inside Maruyama Park, about 10 minutes on foot from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_kaikatei_maruyama.notes: [Café · Maruyama Park, a Showa-era café by the pond] A retro café-restaurant inside Maruyama Park, facing the famous weeping cherry and next to Yasaka Shrine, with window seats and antique furnishings: curries, sandwiches, cakes, floats and beer. gurunavi shows a temporary-closure notice, though a diner visited in August 2025 — call ahead. No cards; no bookings.

chef_bio.background: A café-restaurant inside Maruyama Park, in front of the park’s weeping cherry and next to Yasaka Shrine (Tabelog; April 2017 and March 2022 reviews). gurunavi describes it as a shop of 40 years that renovated in July 2016, keeping its character and adding terrace seats. Reviewers describe a nostalgic Showa-era interior with antique furnishings (August 2025) and a retro-chic room with mostly older customers and many long-time regulars (April 2017).
chef_bio.specialty: Curries of Kyoto ingredients; Sakura Ice in spring.

anecdotes.text: In August 2025 a visitor swapped the soda in the cream soda for cola and called the antique-filled room a perfect place for a quiet moment.
An April 2023 diner who came for lunch at the 10:30 opening learned that lunch starts at 11:00 and had the morning mixed sandwich with coffee (¥800) at a window table.
A March 2022 reviewer returns every spring for the Sakura Ice, eaten on the terrace facing the weeping cherry trees.
On a snowy December 2020 day a first-time visitor found the room more spacious than it looks, with many window seats, but the drinks a little pricey and the sausages served with chopsticks only.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ぐるなび: 円山公園 喫茶・カフェ 開花亭 (マルヤマコウエンキッサカフェカイカテイ)、一時休業中の表示、月〜金11:00〜17:00、土・日・祝10:00〜17:00、花灯路・花見・紅葉の時期のみ夜まで営業、不定休、70席、テラス席、店内全面禁煙、英語メニュー、2016年7月からテラス席、40年続く店がリニューアル、生麩と九条葱とおあげのカレー、季節の京野菜カレー、お酒も呑めます。食べログ: 開花亭 (カイカテイ)、洋食、京都市東山区祇園町北側623 円山公園内、9:00〜18:00、水曜定休、不定休、予約不可、カード不可、60席、喫煙可、2009年のメニュー (エビピラフ、ビーフカレー、カツカレーなど)。口コミ (2017〜2025年、英語と日本語): 抹茶のロールケーキセット850円 (2017年4月)、レトロな店内、しだれ桜の前、Sakura Ice (2022年3月)、フライドポテトとソーセージ3種盛り (2020年12月)、ミックスサンド800円 (2023年4月)、コーラフロート (2025年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (gurunavi); call ahead — gurunavi shows a temporary-closure notice.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (corporate member); latest review August 2025. gurunavi shows a "temporarily closed" notice with no dates.

kyoto_nomidokoro_tb26045619.gf_detail: Ask. Hot pots, karaage, kimbap, pork kakuni and a mentaiko dashi omelette; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_nomidokoro_tb26045619.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an izakaya of hot pots and meat dishes; the namul platter is the likeliest plant dish, but no vegan information is published (reviews).
kyoto_nomidokoro_tb26045619.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last order food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings taken; groups of 11–19 and private hire for 25 or more by phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 24 seats, with counter seats (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). The left-hand shop in the basement of a building on Karasuma just north of Gojo, about 3 minutes from Gojo subway station, with a blackboard sign at street level (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 12 August 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_nomidokoro_tb26045619.notes: [Izakaya · Karasuma-Gojo, opened 2026] A casual basement izakaya with retro posters and the TV on: hot pots, pork kakuni, salt-grilled beef skirt and a run of Korean dishes — kimbap, namul, kimchi, yukgaejang ramen. Counter seats suit solo drinkers. Open to midnight; closed Tuesday. Smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 12 August 2026 (Tabelog; August 2026 review) in the basement of a building on Karasuma Street near Gojo, one of two shops on that floor (August 2026 review). The room has a casual feel with black-toned retro posters and news on the TV (August 2026).

Dropping in after 20:30 on a Sunday in October 2026, a diner got straight in and ran through namul, stuffed peppers, salt-grilled skirt and kakuni, paying ¥50 for a stronger highball.

kyoto_bantan_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori is served mainly with tare (October 2026); the menu runs to karaage, chicken katsu, minced-chicken croquettes, mizutaki and sukiyaki; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).

kyoto_bantan_nijo.hours_raw: Lunch Tuesday–Friday 12:00–13:00 (last order); dinner Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 18:00–22:00 last order (Tabelog); the official site gives dinner as 18:00–22:30 (last order 22:00), closed irregularly. Monday is not listed (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). 48 seats on the 2nd and 3rd floors (Tabelog): counter, tables and a sunken-kotatsu tatami room for up to 24 (official site; 2011–2012 reviews); private hire for 20–50 (Tabelog). Up a spiral staircase in the Bantan Building at the northwest corner of Kawaramachi-Nijo, 3 minutes from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae station (official site; Tabelog; 2011–2012 reviews).
kyoto_bantan_nijo.notes: [Chicken · Kawaramachi-Nijo, from a Nishiki Market poultry family] Up a spiral staircase at Kawaramachi-Nijo, a chicken restaurant led by an owner whose family runs Nishiki Market’s 鳥清: yakitori, chicken sashimi, sanzoku-yaki, and mizutaki in a 10-hour chicken soup. Weekday karaage lunches. A Showa-retro room; an October 2026 diner got in without waiting.

roles: Owner (not named); family home is 鳥清 in Nishiki Market (official site)
chef_bio.background: The owner’s family home is 鳥清, a poultry shop in Nishiki Market, and the owner leads the restaurant on that experience (official site). A 2009 reviewer describes 鳥清 as a chicken and duck specialist with a 90-year history and says the meat comes from there; a 2012 reviewer calls 萬端 a long-established chicken specialist with roots in Nishiki Market. Reviews from 2006 onward mention magazine coverage (Danchu and others, August 2009). An October 2026 reviewer calls it a Showa-retro restaurant.
chef_bio.philosophy: Only same-morning-slaughtered jidori, so many cuts can be served fresh (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Sanzoku-yaki; mizutaki in a 10-hour chicken soup.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, craving yakitori, found the place on Google, had the 10-skewer set for ¥1,900 — mostly with tare, no choice of salt — and finished with soup chazuke; it was easy to get in without waiting.
In June 2011 a diner set on the sanzoku-yaki (¥1,800) asked whether it was too much for one, was shown the dish, and gave up until a return with friends.
A March 2006 first-timer was handed a notebook and brush pen on the way out to leave contact details and comments.
An August 2009 yakitori hunter found the skewers cut very small and thought them gas-grilled, not charcoal, and judged the restaurant better for its other chicken dishes.

kyoto_toriiebisu_shijo.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, live tank and sake] A large fish izakaya with a live tank, courtyard private room and semi-private booths: ikizukuri from the tank, Kyoto oden, obanzai and about 60 sakes. All-you-can-drink courses with sake from ¥6,000 are popular for work dinners. Open daily to 23:30.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 company party of eight took a private room for the ¥6,000 all-you-can-drink course and was impressed by the well-known sake names on the list.
Another April 2026 diner on a ¥7,000 course felt the portions small — one piece of obanzai and one piece of fried sea bream each — while praising the fresh sashimi and the private room.
In September 2026 a diner at the popular shop found several dishes out of stock without being told at ordering, and met red konnyaku for the first time.
A September 2026 traveller liked the deep counter with room for the plates but noted smoke from the smoking room in front of the restrooms.
